snippet.title: Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds - Teaser Trailer - Wishlisht on Steam!
snippet.description:
After some modifications and improvements to our game, we've now made a simple teaser trailer available, including a short gameplay trailer on the Steam page.

Check it out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4060720/Arrow_Survival_15_Seconds/

15 seconds to prove your skill! Dodge, shoot, and survive through 40 chaotic levels packed with deadly traps, insane reflexes, and addictive pixel art action. Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds won’t let you breathe!

Dive into Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds, a thrilling 2D pixel art platformer where every second counts! As a skilled archer, your mission is to survive 15 seconds per level by dodging deadly hazards and strategically firing arrows. Each of the 40 unique levels introduces new challenges, from bouncing platforms that redirect your arrows to treacherous spikes and evolving mechanics that keep you on your toes. 

Music by Marllon Silva (xDeviruchi) - https://www.youtube.com/xdeviruchi
